headline: Top line keeps growing but bottom line barely moves
summary_short: China Merchants Property posted H1 2026 revenue of ¥9.77B, up 6.6% y/y, while net profit attributable to shareholders was essentially flat at ¥498M (+0.15% y/y); Q2 EPS of ¥0.25 rose 13.0% q/q.
summary_long: H1 2026 revenue reached ¥9.77B, up 6.6% y/y. Net profit attributable to shareholders was ¥498M, up just 0.15% y/y — revenue growth did not flow through to the bottom line. Profit excluding non-recurring items rose faster, +5.23% y/y to ¥487M. Q2 standalone EPS of ¥0.25 was up 13.0% q/q from ¥0.2213. No margin, cash-position, or guidance detail was resolvable within the search/fetch budget.
